user.title: Set up Rezepte Import
user.description: Choose the conversation agent for text analysis and the LLM Vision provider for image analysis.

data_description.conversation_agent: Entity ID of the conversation agent – used for text, link, TXT and PDF import. Example: conversation.google_generative_ai
data_description.llmvision_provider: Only relevant if NO Groq API key is set. Used as a fallback for image import in that case. Note: there is a known bug with Google and Groq as LLM Vision provider.
data_description.vision_api_key: API key for image import and scanned PDFs via the Groq Vision API. Free at console.groq.com. If set, LLM Vision is not used.
data_description.vision_model: Groq Vision model for image import. Default: qwen/qwen3.8-27b
data_description.prompt_mode: Choose Standard for the recommended template or Custom prompt for a custom instruction to the AI.
data_description.custom_prompt: Custom instruction for text, link and TXT import. The recipe text is automatically appended at the end.
data_description.image_prompt_mode: Choose Standard for the recommended template or Custom prompt for a custom instruction to the AI.
data_description.custom_image_prompt: Custom instruction for image import. The image is passed directly to the Vision API.
